content:
We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically to the given molecule reproduces the carbonyl-ene reaction (intramolecular). The given initial molecule SMILES: [CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]

We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (integer). The template_id is the one used to search the database, not the hash. So we need to search for a template that matches this transformation. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with appropriate functional groups broken/formed.

The reaction: carbonyl-ene: a carbonyl (ketone) and an alkene undergo ene reaction forming new C-C bond and converting C=O to C-O (hydroxyl) and C=C to C-C (single). So functional groups broken: ketones, C-C double bonds. Formed: aliphatic hydroxyls, five-membered rings (since intramolecular forms a ring). Also new C-C bond formed.

Thus functional_groups_broken: ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"]; functional_groups_formed: ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "five-membered rings"]; bonds_broken: ["C=O", "C=C"]; bonds_formed: ["C-C", "C-O"]; limit maybe 10.

Let's try search with those strings exactly as in list.
